title: Orchestrated adminlet staging harness for deterministic runbook-as-task execution
creator: Ava Liu
description: Build a lightweight staging harness (adminlet) that materializes runbooks as versioned tasks, provides deterministic replay in a staging namespace, and creates a safe handoff for oncall to promote task bundles to production. The harness should support: dry-run mode, idempotent step adapters, telemetry hooks to Console (per-step latency/cost), and a canary promotion workflow guarded by feature flags.
rationale: Oncall and SREs need a low-friction, auditable way to convert runbooks into executable task bundles that can be rehearsed against synthetic environments. Current hand-exec flow is error-prone and lacks replay/safety primitives. This harness will reduce mean time to remediation for common ops tasks and improve auditability.
acceptance_criteria: Can convert an existing approved runbook into a task bundle via CLI: redwood-adminlet bundle create --runbook-id <id>
Staging namespace exists and executes task bundles in dry-run mode without making stateful changes (verified by synthetic checks)
Per-step telemetry emitted to Console: step_start/step_end, token_count estimate, execution_duration
Rollback-on-failure policy implemented and validated in integration tests
Feature-flagged canary promotion: a bundle promoted to canary and then to production when gates pass
design_decisions: Use existing runbook schema (YAML) as canonical source and extend with a task metadata section for idempotency hints
Run tasks in ephemeral containerized sandbox within staging VPC to ensure network restrictions and prevent accidental production writes
Emit telemetry via the Console events API to leverage existing dashboards and tracing; do not introduce a new telemetry store
Keep execution engine lightweight: reuse ops-runlet binary with a thin adminlet wrapper for bundling and promotion
risks: Potential for accidental production writes if sandboxing is misconfigured — mitigated via policy tests and pre-flight assertions
Increased maintenance surface for adminlet CLI; balance scope to avoid becoming full orchestration project
Security review required for artifacts that may contain credential references — must integrate KMS/HSM and secret-scrubbing
rollout_plan: MVP: implement bundling + dry-run execution in staging with telemetry (internal alpha)
Invite two oncall squads to rehearse 10 canonical runbooks over 2 weeks and collect feedback
Iterate on idempotency adapters and add rollback policies
Enable feature flag for canary promotion in production for a single team, monitor for 2 weeks
Gradual rollout to all squads and document SOPs in Confluence
qa_checklist: Unit tests for bundle parser and idempotency hint enforcement
Integration tests for dry-run mode asserting zero side effects
End-to-end rehearsal with synthetic tenants and verification dashboards
Threat model review and penetration smoke tests
Canary promotion failover tests (force step failure and assert rollback)
